'''Lufta Shif''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who served as the [[Education Regent]] of the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council]] during the [[Republic Era|Fall of the Republic]]. As a [[minister]] she was tasked with advising the [[monarch of Naboo]] and guiding public policy throughout [[Naboo]].<ref name="CVD" />

In [[32 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> Shif was present in the [[Theed Royal Palace]] serving [[Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation]].<ref name="Episode I">{{Film|I}}</ref>
